selection_rule: PRE-COMMITTED before any selected row was read: from bench/memory/results/2026-09-08-p1-185920/judged.jsonl in file order, take rows at 0-based index i where i % 5 == 3 (i.e. rows 3, 8, 13, ..., 98) — every 5th judged row, phase 3. scoring_protocol: Each item was hand-scored EXACT / PARTIAL / WRONG from the question, the gold reference answer and the model answer ONLY, applying the same rubric the local judge was given (bench/memory/judge.mjs judgePrompt): EXACT = states the gold fact, essentially equivalent wording fine; PARTIAL = same topic but incomplete, vague, or imprecise vs the gold; WRONG = factually incorrect, asserts something different, or does not answer the question.
